conviction_note: Near non-result: the company's own Q3 phasing (Magic up mid-single digits, Consumer Products up low single digits) implies revenue near $1.44bn, below the $1.47-1.48bn consensus. But the consensus mix leans toward the low-margin segment: CP is modelled at +6.3% against a low-single-digit guide, and Wizards at +2.5% against Magic guided +MSD. Hasbro has beaten four quarters running. Against that sit a put-bid skew of +9.8 vol points and a +13.5% 20-day run-up. Findings net to +0.6, p_up is 53 on abs 8.5, and the scaled number is +0.51. Both measurements are small and agree in sign.
bar: Q3 2026 revenue $1.47bn and adj EPS $1.88 (Zacks, via https://www.tradingview.com/news/zacks:173beebb5094b:0-hasbro-gears-up-for-q3-earnings-will-magic-drive-growth/), and $1.48bn / $1.86 (Benzinga via Investing.com, 2026-10-19, https://ng.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/hasbro-earnings-ahead-as-gaming-division-powers-expected-beat-93CH-2743854). Two sources agree within 1%. Zacks segment model: Wizards $586.4m (+2.5%), Consumer Products $847.3m (+6.3%). Company guide (Q2 8-K, 2026-07-21, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000046080/000004608026000044/exhibit991q22026.htm): FY revenue +5-7% cc, adj op margin 25-26%, adj EBITDA $1.45-1.50bn. Q2 call phasing (https://www.webull.com/news/15265615122539520): Magic Q3 +MSD and Q4 -LSD; CP Q3 and Q4 each +LSD; Wizards FY +low double digits.
positioning_check: Short interest is about 5.2% of float with 2.5 days to cover (Equibles, Aug 2026, https://equibles.com/stocks/has/shortinterest), and 5.8% and rising per Benzinga as of 2026-09-25 (https://kr.benzinga.com/quote/HAS/sentiment). That is not crowded. Skew is +9.82 vol points (puts bid) with put/call OI 0.49. The 20-day run-up is +13.5% and the 5-day +5.1%, leaving the stock 6% below its 52-week high. The event-implied move is 8.37%. Citi raised its target to $117 on 2026-10-13. Zacks Rank is #4 with ESP 0, and EPS estimates are down 0.5-0.9% over 30-60 days.

findings.finding: The consensus revenue bar sits above management's own Q3 phasing, but the mix gap favours profit. Guided phasing (CP +LSD on the ~$800m Q3'25 base, which fell 7.3% on order timing; Magic +MSD; Wizards Q3'25 $572m) implies total revenue of about $1.43-1.45bn against consensus $1.47-1.48bn. Within that, Zacks models CP +6.3% ($847m), above the LSD guide, and Wizards only +2.5% ($586m), below a Magic +MSD guide. Wizards runs at a ~40% margin against 6-8% for CP, so a CP shortfall offset by a Wizards beat leaves EPS near the bar and revenue slightly light.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 beat revenue by about 7.5% with a raised guide and rose +8.81%. Q1 2026 (2026-05-20) printed revenue +13% and fell -8.83%. Six of the last eight prints rose (baseline).
findings.why_not_priced: Consensus at +6% sits above the ~+4% the call phasing implies. If the market held the guided phasing, the revenue bar would be about $1.44bn. That gap is the sell side pricing a habitual beat (average EPS surprise 23.6%), so a print merely in line with the guided phasing reads as a revenue miss.
findings.independence: The segment bar is Zacks only (https://www.tradingview.com/news/zacks:173beebb5094b:0-hasbro-gears-up-for-q3-earnings-will-magic-drive-growth/). The Q3'25 base is from the Q3'25 10-Q (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/46080/000004608025000164/has-20250928.htm). This finding shares the call transcript with the Magic and guidance findings.

findings.finding: Magic Q3 drivers point at or above the +MSD guide, against a consensus Wizards line of only +2.5%. Marvel Super Heroes set day-one and month-one records and passed LOTR as the #2 Universes Beyond set (ICv2, 2026-07-21). Reality Fracture shipped for 2026-09-25 prereleases inside Q3, with reports of sold-out and expanded prerelease events and 'unusually positive' reception (CardLines, 2026-10-02). The Hobbit (2026-08-14) was guided as smaller than Marvel, so it is in the guide.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The stock has traded on Wizards. Q2 Magic +32% with a raise bought +8.81%. Q1 Magic +36% still fell -8.83%.
findings.why_not_priced: The Zacks segment model at +2.5% Wizards sits below the company's own Magic +MSD guide. If priced, the segment bar would be at or above guide. The prerelease evidence is anecdotal and not in the wire previews.
findings.independence: UBS (Kocharyan) expects 'likely double digit % Wizard segment growth' (Investing.com, 2026-10-19, https://ng.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/hasbro-earnings-ahead-as-gaming-division-powers-expected-beat-93CH-2743854). The Marvel record is from https://icv2.com/print/article/62920.

findings.finding: The US toy market was strong into Q3. Circana H1 2026 dollar sales rose +17% (strongest in six years), Games & Puzzles +45% and licensed +24% (Circana, 2026-08-12), and UBS calls Q3 POS 'broadly positive for the quarter'. Hasbro CP lagged the industry, though: Q2 CP was +5% including a ~$25m cyber hit, so transmission to Hasbro is unconfirmed. Management said the Q2 cyber shortfall is recouped in H2.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: CP is a secondary line. Q3'25 CP -7% on order timing came with a Wizards beat, and the stock rose +3.7%.
findings.why_not_priced: Hasbro's CP guide stays at +LSD despite an industry running +17%. If the market believed transmission, the CP guide would be expected to rise. It is an industry proxy, so it is sized small.
findings.independence: UBS POS comment via https://ng.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/hasbro-earnings-ahead-as-gaming-division-powers-expected-beat-93CH-2743854 (2026-10-19). The proxy is not confirmed by the company.

findings.finding: Hasbro's 10-Q (filed 2026-07-30) says that in Q3 2026 it made its first CBP application for a refund of 'a majority of the IEEPA tariffs we paid'. By mid-September CBP had certified and sent about $122bn of refunds to Treasury (C.H. Robinson, 2026-09-17), so a refund may be recognised in Q3. The amount is undisclosed.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No Hasbro history on this line. Across four other names, tariff refunds landed and the stock followed the guidance direction, not the refund.
findings.why_not_priced: No amount is disclosed, so consensus cannot carry it. If priced, EPS estimates would have risen into the print, but they fell 0.5-0.9%. It is a one-off with no stated path to the guide, so it is sized at a fraction.

findings.finding: The guide is beatable. Hasbro raised FY guidance at Q1 and again at Q2 (revenue +5-7% cc, EBITDA $1.45-1.50bn). The midpoint (~$4.985bn) less H1 (~$2.135bn: Q1 ~$995m plus Q2 $1,139.6m) implies H2 of about $2.85bn, roughly flat against H2'25 ($1,387.5m + $1,445.9m = $2,833m). Q4 Magic is guided -LSD, with about $40m moving into Q1'27. A Q3 at consensus would leave room for a third raise.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Raise at Q2: +8.81%. Q1: raised guidance yet fell -8.83%. Q3'25 raise: +3.7%.
findings.why_not_priced: A third raise would mean the sell side holds FY above the guide. FY EPS consensus of $6.16 has edged down, not up, so no raise is in estimates.
findings.independence: FY2025 revenue of $4.7bn and Q4'25 of $1,445.9m: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20260209085774/en (2026-02-10). Q1'26 revenue of ~$1bn: https://corp.hasbro.com/node/38146. This shares the Q2 release with finding 1.

findings.finding: Positioning raises the bar. The stock ran +13.5% over 20 days and +5.1% in the last week, to about $99.6, after Citi's target raise to $117 on 10-13. Puts are bid (skew +9.82). Zacks Rank is #4 Sell with ESP 0.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1'26 came after a strong run and was sold off -8.83%. No other run-up data is in the baseline.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced by construction. The skew already says downside is paid for, so this finding agrees with the skew and is sized small.
findings.independence: Baseline tape and options. Short interest is only 5-6% of float (https://equibles.com/stocks/has/shortinterest), so squeeze fuel is limited.

findings.finding: Capital return and financing. The CFO said Hasbro is 'leaning into' its $1bn buyback, yet Q2 repurchases were only $33.8m. $400m of new notes were issued to fully repay the November 2026 maturities, a refinancing with no distress. A step-up in Q3 buybacks would show in the release.
findings.why_not_priced: The Q3 repurchase pace is unknown until the release. Financing answer: the notes refinance a dated maturity, so the sign is neutral to positive.
findings.independence: Q2 10-Q: $33.8m repurchased in Q2 and $41.5m year to date (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000046080/000004608026000050/has-20260628.htm).

findings.finding: Insider selling after the Q2 print: Kilpin sold 20,000 shares at $93.12 on 7/28 (tax withholding on vesting), and CFO Goetter sold 8,265 at $93.96 on 7/31. Insiders sold about $4.7m over 90 days.
findings.why_not_priced: The sales are public Form 4s, small and partly tax-driven, so this is near zero.

findings.finding: H2 cost step-up is guided: higher royalties, about $20m of marketing for video-game launches, and 2026 as the 'peak investment year' for digital. The Exodus and Warlock games are planned for 2027. Wizards margin is guided in the low-40% range.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Q2 Wizards margin of 41%, including a $56m impairment, was still bought +8.81%.
findings.why_not_priced: It is inside the guide, so it should be priced. It is filed small because Zacks cites higher royalty and marketing costs as a margin drag and a commentary miss could surprise.
findings.independence: Zacks preview cites the same costs (https://www.tradingview.com/news/zacks:173beebb5094b:0-hasbro-gears-up-for-q3-earnings-will-magic-drive-growth/). This shares the call transcript with findings 1 and 2.

baseline_tension: The net is mildly positive, against a +9.8 put-bid skew and a +13.5% run-up. The positive findings are guide-versus-consensus inference and proxies, not an unpriced company number, so p_up stays near 50 (53).
lessons_applied: Lesson 2: tariff-refund one-off with no amount and no path to the guide cut from +0.5 to +0.3.
Lesson 5: Circana industry proxy cut from +0.7 to +0.5, since Hasbro CP lagged the industry in Q2.
Lesson 5/6: Magic finding cut from +1.0 to +0.8; it rests on prerelease anecdote, and the segment bar has one source (Zacks).
Lesson 1: guidance-raise finding cut from +0.8 to +0.6, because Q1 2026 raised and still fell -8.83%.
Lesson 7: a net long against put-bid skew moved p_up from 54 to 53; the positioning finding at -1.0 was left standing.
